title: quota_enforcement.zig's readUsageForDimension reads PER_TENANT tables (instance_projections, instance_waits, dead_letter_items) unqualified via pool -- fails for every LEGACY_RLS-mode tenant
discovered_in: WF03-GH566-20260808 (ISS-0617/GH-566), incidental discovery during BACKEND-DEV implementation
symptom: quota_middleware.check() -> readUsageForDimension() -> countRows()/maxColumn()/countRowsWhereRecent() issue unqualified SQL (e.g. "SELECT COUNT(*)::text FROM instance_projections WHERE tenant_id = $1::uuid") against a `pool.acquire()`-ed connection. instance_projections, instance_waits, and dead_letter_items are genuine PER_TENANT tables replayed once per tenant schema by migrations/001_event_store.sql's runForSchema() machinery (see that file's own header comment) -- they have NO copy in the public schema at all. For any tenant whose storage_mode resolves to .LEGACY_RLS (src/db/pool.zig's documented default for every tenant that never had tenant.storage_mode explicitly set to 'SCHEMA'), applyRequestStorageRouting emits exactly `SET search_path TO public` with no fallback -- so these three tables are structurally unreachable from that connection, and every quota check against .entity_write, .sandbox_allocate, or .agent_retry targets fails with QuotaUsageReadFailed (surfaced to callers as a 503 'quota check unavailable', src/main.zig lines 543-553).
root_cause_analysis: Confirmed via live pg_constraint/information_schema inspection against bpm_test (docker exec r-co-2-db_test-1): `\dt public.instance_projections`, `\dt public.instance_waits`, `\dt public.dead_letter_items` all return 'Did not find any relation' -- these tables exist ONLY as `tenant_default.<name>` (and per-schema copies for SCHEMA-mode tenants), never in `public`. Confirmed src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting (lines 258-301): the .LEGACY_RLS branch (lines 277-283) issues `SET search_path TO public` unconditionally, with no tenant_default fallback -- unlike the .SCHEMA branch (lines 284-299) which sets `search_path TO tenant_{slug},public`. Confirmed resolveAndCacheStorageMode (pool.zig lines 183-234) falls through to .LEGACY_RLS whenever a tenant row exists with storage_mode unset/NULL, or has no public.tenant row and no tenant_schemas entry -- i.e. .LEGACY_RLS is the DEFAULT for any tenant not explicitly promoted to schema-per-tenant mode. Empirically reproduced: tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig's TC-EXP-601-02 (entity_write target, reads instance_projections) and TC-EXP-601-04 (sandbox_allocate target, reads instance_waits) both fail with PoolError.QueryFailed / PgError.ServerError from quota_enforcement.zig's countRows(), confirmed via live test run against bpm_test with BPM_TEST_DB_URL. This reproduces for ANY .LEGACY_RLS tenant, not just the test fixture -- it is a production-path defect, not a test-only artifact. The .file_write target (reads repository_artifacts, which DOES have a public copy after GBL-134/GBL-135/GBL-136) is unaffected, which is why TC-EXP-601-03 passes.
upstream_defect: src/api/middleware/quota_enforcement.zig's readUsageForDimension/countRows/maxColumn/countRowsWhereRecent were written assuming these three usage tables are reachable unqualified from any pool connection, without accounting for the two-mode (LEGACY_RLS vs SCHEMA) storage routing that src/db/pool.zig actually implements. The .SCHEMA branch's search_path (tenant_{slug},public) would make these unqualified reads work correctly; the .LEGACY_RLS branch's search_path (public only) cannot, because these tables were never created in public. A correct fix needs either: (a) resolve storage_mode explicitly in quota_enforcement.zig and issue schema-qualified queries (tenant_default.<table> for LEGACY_RLS tenants), or (b) create public-schema equivalents/views for these three tables so both storage modes can read them unqualified, or (c) a third option this issue does not prescribe -- needs CODE-DESIGNER analysis of which storage-mode convention the rest of the quota subsystem (and any sibling middleware with the same pattern) is meant to follow. Not diagnosed to a specific fix in this issue; diagnosis stops at confirmed root cause per this run's scope (WF03-GH566 was scoped to ISS-0617's repository_artifacts issue, not this one).
verification_method: Live-ran `zig build test-integration-exp601` (newly wired build step, see GH-566's PR) against workspace r-co-2's test DB (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5453/bpm_test). TC-EXP-601-02 and TC-EXP-601-04 both fail with QueryFailed/ServerError specifically at the countRows() call reading instance_projections / instance_waits respectively -- full stack traces captured in the WF03-GH566-20260808 BACKEND-DEV handoff. Independently confirmed via `docker exec r-co-2-db_test-1 psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c "\dt public.instance_projections"` (and the same for instance_waits, dead_letter_items) that none of the three exist in public. Confirmed src/db/pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting source directly (not inferred) for the exact SET search_path statement issued in each mode.
acceptance_criteria: quota_middleware.check() succeeds (or fails only for policy/business reasons, never QuotaUsageReadFailed) for a .LEGACY_RLS-mode tenant exercising .entity_write, .sandbox_allocate, and .agent_retry targets
TC-EXP-601-02 and TC-EXP-601-04 in tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig pass without any test-fixture schema workaround
Fix does not regress .SCHEMA-mode tenants' quota checks

Design documents which storage-mode convention quota_enforcement.zig's usage-reading functions must follow, and whether any other middleware shares this same unqualified-read-via-pool pattern against PER_TENANT-only tables (a broader audit may be warranted)

additional_findings.found_in: WF03-GH516-20260808 (ISS-0183/GH-516), incidental discovery while re-running the full zig build to check for regressions; not fixed there -- out of that run's scope
additional_findings.note: TC-EXP-601-04 now also fails one layer earlier than this issue's original QuotaUsageReadFailed diagnosis: the test fixture's own INSERT INTO instance_waits (kind='sandbox', ...) at tests/integration/exp601_tier_quota_test.zig ~line 337 violates migrations/093_exp103_instance_waits.sql's CHECK (kind IN ('timer','catch_event','human_task')) constraint (Postgres C23514). 'sandbox' is not an allowed kind value. This is a second, independent bug on top of the LEGACY_RLS unqualified-read defect this issue already tracks, both blocking the same test case. Whoever implements this issue's fix should also correct (or justify) the fixture's kind literal. Queued via python3 tools/queue_add.py; commented on GH #576.
